BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motorcycle safety training curriculum; amendingRCW 46.82.420; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.220 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.220RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The superintendent of public instruction shall include informationon motorcycle awareness, approved by the Motorcycle Safety Foundation,in instructional material used in traffic safety education courses, toensure new operators of motor vehicles have been instructed in theimportance of safely sharing the road with motorcyclists.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.82.420 and 1991 c 217 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The advisory committee shall compile and furnish to each qualifyingapplicant for an instructor's license or a driver training schoollicense a basic minimum required curriculum. The basic minimumrequired curriculum shall also include (1) information on the effectsof alcohol and drug use on motor vehicle operators, includinginformation on drug and alcohol related traffic injury and mortality p. 1 SB 6439rates in the state of Washington((, and)); (2) current penalties fordriving under the influence of drugs or alcohol; and (3) information onmotorcycle awareness, approved by the Motorcycle Safety Foundation, toensure new operators of motor vehicles have been instructed in theimportance of safely sharing the road with motorcyclists. Should thedirector be presented with acceptable proof that any licensedinstructor or driver training school is not showing proper diligence inteaching such basic minimum curriculum as required, the instructor orschool shall be required to appear before the advisory committee andshow cause why the license of the instructor or school should not berevoked for such negligence. If the committee does not accept suchreasons as may be offered, the director may revoke the license of theinstructor or school, or both.
